Once again, it's impossible to win this battle, so feel free to just wail away at him until he uses the !!! attack to reduce your HP to 1, followed by being knocked out once again.

To sum up everything that the Masks have said: The Talisman Yuri holds will show the level of Malice that has accumulated in his soul. To rid himself of the Malice, he must return to the Graveyard and fight an incarnate of his Malice to keep from having to face Fox Face in battle. Each enemy you defeat will increase the Malice Meter, so make sure that your Malice level (found in the menu) does NOT reach the red. If it does, IMMEDIATELY go to the Graveyard and fight your Malice so that you don't fight Fox Face. Right now, you WILL die if you try to fight him, so if you run into him, press the R1 button and choose to Run Away. NOTE     You also will now see the Soul Energy screen after battle. It shows

You can fight Evil 1, Evil 2, Evil 3, and even Evil 4 again by returning to the Graveyard and fighting them when your Malice level is at a certain color: - Evil 1: Between Blue and Turquoise. - Evil 2: Between Turquoise and Green. - Evil 3: Between Green and Yellow. - Evil 4: Between Yellow and Red. - After each battle, you'll receive an item based on your Malice! The only issue with this is that it's a number the system tracks that you cannot see. The levels change at 25/50/75/100, and the early monsters seem to contribute 1 point each toward the total, and it seems that as you go through the game, the stronger monsters give more points. It's something you kind of have to guess point values           as you go; it's more of a guideline than anything, since it just shows what's possible to get by doing so.

After some dialogue, you'll regain control. Take a few steps to the upper-left
to find a [_PURE LEAF_] on the ground, then head down to the next area. Instead
of following the path, go right into the grass and to the next area, where
you'll find a chest containing a [_LEATHER BELT_]. Go ahead and equip this to
the Rude Hero. Head back and follow the path west until you find the girl. This
will allow you to continue the dialogue, where you'll be able to name your
characters. The default names are Yuri for the Rude Hero and Alice for the Girl
In Danger, and I will be referring to them by their default names throughout
the guide. Alice will join your party, and you'll regain control.

  NOTE     Alice comes equipped with a [_SMALL BIBLE_], a [_COTTON BLOUSE_],
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   and a [_BANDANNA_] by default, and also comes with the [_PENDANT_]
           valuable.

Start to head southeast and examine the body of water to your south. You can't
cross it yet, so take a few steps southeast. Before stepping on the bridge,
look just below where you're standing to find a [_MERMAID'S TEAR_]. Continue
southeast to the next area, where Alice notes that we need to do something with
the sluice gate to keep going, so that's our next task.

Before doing that, head north to the fork, then go east and past the fork here,
following the path as it turns north and west to another sluice gate. Examine
it to find out that you need a handle to use it. Now go back to the last fork
and use the Save Point to the southeast to save, that way if you accidentally
mess up the next task, you can reload and retry it. In any case, there are two
ways to handle this next task; read them both before deciding which one to try:

1) Examine the sparkling Sluice Gate handle at the bottom part of the screen.
   You'll have to do a "Push Ring" to be able to get the handle, meaning that
   you have to push the CROSS button several times in order to get the
   indicator within the allowed range, then press it intermittently to keep it
   in that area until the time expires. Doing this successfully the first time
   will not only net you the handle, but also a Leather Belt (raises Attack)
   here after a sequence of events. If you fail the first time, but succeed the
   second, you'll receive a Thera Seed, and if you succeed the third or any
   time after, you'll receive a Thera Leaf.

2) Examine the sparkling Sluice Gate handle at the top part of the screen.
   You'll have to do a "Normal Ring" to be able to get the handle, meaning that
   you have to push the CROSS button three times when the indicator is within
   the allowed ranges, just like in battle. Doing this successfully the first
   time will not only net you the handle, but also a Bandanna (raises Defense)
   here after a sequence of events. If you fail the first time, but succeed the
   second, you'll receive a Mana Seed, and if you succeed the third or any time
   after, you'll receive a Mana Leaf.

Regardless of how you decided to get it, you'll receive the
[_SLUICEGATEHANDLE_]. Head back to the northeastern side of this area and use
the SluiceGateHandle on the Sluice Gate to lower the water running through the
plain. Start to make your way back to the previous area, and they'll decide to
take a rest for a while. Shortly after Alice falls asleep, a mysterious figure
known as Fox Face will appear, and you'll have to fight him in battle.

  NOTE     Once again, it's impossible to win this battle, so feel free to just
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   wail away at him until he uses the !!! attack to reduce your HP to
           1, followed by being knocked out once again.

After the battle, you'll be in the Graveyard, the one in Yuri's dreams. When
you gain control, head north and examine the glowing green tombstone to be
thrown into a battle, this time with the Raging Tiger.

      .————————————.
     / * SUB-BOSS * \
.———'————————————————'——.———————————.——————————————.——————————————————————————.
| Raging Tiger          |    75 HP  | Class: Earth |                          |
|———————————————————————'———————————'——————————————'——————————————————————————|
|                                                                             |
|  Hey, we can win this one! Go ahead and use Yuri's Fusion skill to become   |
|  the Death Emperor, then use normal attacks to wipe out the Raging Tiger.   |
|  He's not tough at all, and should take just a couple turns to take out.    |
|                                                                             |
'—————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————'

By defeating him in battle, Yuri can now equip the soul of [_RAGING TIGER_],
Tigerion! Be sure to equip it in the menu. Next, head west and talk to the
Masks here, who'll tell you that you need to defeat the accumulation of Malice
within you to be able to leave the Graveyard. You'll then enter a battle with
Evil 4. He's pretty easy; just fuse into the Raging Tiger and dish out some
strong hits to take him out in a turn or two.

  NOTE     To sum up everything that the Masks have said: The Talisman Yuri
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   holds will show the level of Malice that has accumulated in his
           soul. To rid himself of the Malice, he must return to the Graveyard
           and fight an incarnate of his Malice to keep from having to face Fox
           Face in battle. Each enemy you defeat will increase the Malice
           Meter, so make sure that your Malice level (found in the menu) does
           NOT reach the red. If it does, IMMEDIATELY go to the Graveyard and
           fight your Malice so that you don't fight Fox Face. Right now, you
           WILL die if you try to fight him, so if you run into him, press the
           R1 button and choose to Run Away.

  NOTE     You also will now see the Soul Energy screen after battle. It shows
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   you how many points away you are from leveling up a class. Once a
           class is leveled, you can visit the Graveyard and obtain a new
           Fusion by examining the glowing gravestones (but only up to level 1
           Fusions for now; level 2 will be available later in the game.) If
           you're confused about how Malice and the Graveyard work, check out
           the Help section in the menu for a full explanation.

Once you're done with the Masks, head east and back out into the real world,
where Alice will rejoin and you'll regain control.

  NOTE     You can fight Evil 1, Evil 2, Evil 3, and even Evil 4 again by
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   returning to the Graveyard and fighting them when your Malice level
           is at a certain color:

           - Evil 1: Between Blue and Turquoise.
           - Evil 2: Between Turquoise and Green.
           - Evil 3: Between Green and Yellow.
           - Evil 4: Between Yellow and Red.
           - After each battle, you'll receive an item based on your Malice!

  NOTE     The prize you win depends on the level of Malice you have
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   accumulated, with 100 being the max value. Sadly you can't use this
           knowledge to get the special prizes again and again, as they are
           replaced with a Thera Leaf the second time you clear the Malice at
           the same value.

  NOTE     The only issue with this is that it's a number the system tracks
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   that you cannot see. The levels change at 25/50/75/100, and the
           early monsters seem to contribute 1 point each toward the total, and
           it seems that as you go through the game, the stronger monsters give
           more points. It's something you kind of have to guess point values           as you go; it's more of a guideline than anything, since it just
           shows what's possible to get by doing so.

From the Save Point, make your way back to the screen with the bridge and the
river. There will be a chest here down below the bridge; open it to receive one
of the following:

   - A [_LEATHER BELT_] if you got the southern gate's handle the first try.
   - A [_THERA SEED_] if you got the southern gate's handle the second try.
   - A [_THERA LEAF_] if you got the southern gate's handle the third or more
     tries.
   - A [_BANDANNA_] if you got the northern gate's handle the first try.
   - A [_MANA SEED_] if you got the northern gate's handle the second try.
   - A [_THERA LEAF_] if you got the northern gate's handle the third or more
     tries.

Once you have your treasure, head back across the bridge, then cross the river
bank to the southwest and follow the path to the next area. Take a few steps to
the left for an event, then open the chest to your northwest when you regain
control for a [_HOLY MOTHER BUST_]. Continue to the village gates, where you'll
be able to enter after some short discussion.
